change_summary: Honor an unambiguous current user correction to Workspace Project identity or relationship before escalating unresolved source authority.

canonical_skill.note: The canonical Skill treats a clear current identity, relationship or owner correction as authority for that bounded change, preserves old material as lineage, and asks only when ambiguity remains.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-16.1 orders current user correction before unresolved-conflict escalation across MCP hosts while preserving Agent-owned planning and typed Runtime receipts.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.50 without changing transport, trust, consent, or compatibility-family boundaries.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace/Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.32; registry-backed update checks return an exact install command plus post-install verification, and Workspace capabilities expose server-owned limits.

help_center.note: Public guidance explains that a clear current structural correction resolves the bounded authority choice while older records remain lineage.

package_setup.note: Setup and SessionStart put current user structural correction before unresolved-conflict questions without changing write consent.

harness_and_mainline.note: The owner history records the fresh Claude split-then-correct trace and keeps current user authority, preserved lineage and Runtime execution as separate decisions without adding a semantic fallback.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party 1.7.50 publication and hashes can be verified here; Claude directory acceptance and fresh secondary-host behavior remain external receipts.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover current-correction precedence, unresolved-conflict countercases, MCP transport size, adapter convergence, package export and localized Help; a fresh semantic rerun is the live behavior gate.
